title: Cursor 3.0 - New Interface
description: Cursor 3 introduces a completely new interface centered around agents, allowing parallel agent execution across repos and environments (local, worktrees, cloud, SSH). Features include a new Agents Window, Design Mode for browser UI annotation, Agent Tabs for multiple simultaneous chats, and significant performance improvements including faster large-file diff rendering.
